capabilities: Generate quizzes, three-tier exams and CTF-style labs from your notes with Claude
Schedule daily reviews with FSRS, including fill-in-the-blank questions from ==highlights==
Mark written, shell-command and image answers through the Claude Code CLI
Show per-heading memory dots, due counts, a skill radar and session history with streaks
Offer help when stuck: nudges, guided steps, a leech clinic and Teach it back
extras: Desktop only, macOS or Linux (Windows untested); needs Obsidian 1.7.2+. Free, runs on the user's own Claude subscription with no API key; no telemetry. Binary lab challenges are compiled and verified in a throwaway Docker container, not on the user's machine.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to generate and grade study material from notes, so learners must write flashcards and quiz questions by hand.

relations.evidence: Claude writes them and marks open answers through the Claude Code CLI

summary: Study plugin that turns notes into FSRS-scheduled reviews, tiered exams, CTF-style labs and a skill radar, written and marked by Claude via the Claude Code CLI.
